_README: Measured results, with the tool and date that produced each. This file
exists so figures are generated from recorded numbers rather than from
numbers retyped into a slide, which is how a deck drifts from the truth.
Cheap measurements are recomputed live by the figure script. The ones
here are the expensive ones (minutes of model loading) or the ones that
need data that is gitignored. Re-run the named tool to refresh them.
NOTHING IN THIS PROJECT IS TRAINED. There is no loss curve because there
was no training run. These are evaluation and deployment measurements.

quantisation._host: Apple M4, ONNX Runtime 1.28.0, CoreML EP available
quantisation._note: fp32_best uses CoreML where the graph loads; int8 is CPU-only because ORT has no INT8 CoreML path

degradation._note: reference image contains 2 people; 'people' is how many YOLO11n still finds
degradation._finding: noise is survivable, blur is fatal — which inverted the camera configuration

latency._note: face stage runs on ~26% of frames, so its contribution to the mean is amortised

lag_stability._note: residual oscillation, degrees peak-to-peak, after the subject stops moving
